name: onstage-worship
description: Church presentation software with an offline AI assistant that puts Bible verses on screen as they are mentioned.
author: OnStage

scripts.dist:win: npm run prepare-web && npm run fetch-models && electron-builder --win --x64 --publish never
scripts.dist:mac: npm run prepare-web && npm run fetch-models && electron-builder --mac --publish never
scripts.dist:linux: npm run prepare-web && npm run fetch-models && electron-builder --linux --x64 --publish never
scripts.dist:win-on-linux: npm run prepare-web && npm run fetch-models && node scripts/build-win-on-linux.js
